comparison: Current draft against one publicly accessible author-hosted version of Din et al., Multimodal Fusion with Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
method: Case-insensitive normalized exact 8-token sequence matching; draft figures, tables, equations, citation keys and bibliography excluded; matching spans count union coverage of current-draft tokens.
version_limit: Author-hosted 43-page copy; not verified byte-identical to the published journal version.
interpretation_limit: This local lexical comparison is not iThenticate/Turnitin, not a plagiarism percentage, and does not detect conceptual reuse, close paraphrase, or overlap with other sources. PDF text extraction can miss matches.
extraction: Poppler pdftotext reading-order extraction; checked against layout extraction after pypdf merged adjacent words.
